why: I checked all six expect lines and their proofs. Each one can be checked at the PR head with local tools. Lines 1–4 are exact-output `run` commands: `printf ... | node bin/csv2json.js [--tsv]` and an inline `node --input-type=module` import of src/parse.js. Each gives one precise answer, and the stated default-mode outputs match the current behaviour described in the problem. Line 5 needs `npm test` to exit 0 plus `grep -- '--tsv' test/*.js` and a read of the matching test. That is all in the repo, though "asserts its JSON output" needs a little judgement when reading it. Line 6 is a `read` of README.md for a --tsv usage example, which a reader can confirm in the branch. No line depends on a release, deploy, published page or npm publish, and publishing is listed as a non-goal.
